name: our-platform
description: Hallazia: plataforma local de investigación y creación basada en evidencia.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,server,web "npm run dev --workspace @our-platform/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @our-platform/server" "npm run dev --workspace @our-platform/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @our-platform/server && npm run build --workspace @our-platform/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @our-platform/shared && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @our-platform/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @our-platform/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @our-platform/server
